Our AI legal research assistant has been running for about a week and we've accumulated a good set of behavioral logs. The agent has clearly developed some patterns — it keeps getting corrected on the same things, and we've also noticed it's starting to behave more autonomously than it used to.

We need you to update the agent's self-profile document so it accurately reflects what it's actually doing now. The profile lives somewhere in the memory folder. Also, the agent has a behavior tracking file that records recurring patterns — if any pattern is strong enough, it should be promoted/crystallized accordingly.

Don't touch the agent's foundational identity document (if one exists). Only update the living, evolving self-model.

Please produce an updated self-profile and make sure the behavior tracking data reflects the current state of any mature patterns.
